metadata.purpose: Additional sources to consider for epistemic diversity. NOT a trust list.
metadata.inclusion_criteria: Established institutions or knowledge systems with documented methodologies

academic.name: African Academy of Sciences
academic.description: Pan-African peer-reviewed science policy and research body

academic.name: CODESRIA (Council for the Development of Social Science Research in Africa)
academic.description: Social science network producing journals and policy analysis grounded in African contexts

institutional.name: African Union Commission
institutional.description: Continental policy body producing data and reports on governance, health, and development

institutional.name: UNECA (UN Economic Commission for Africa)
institutional.description: Regional UN body generating economic data and development reports for Africa

community.name: Pambazuka News
community.description: Pan-African platform for civil society analysis and grassroots perspectives

academic.name: Asian Development Bank Institute
academic.description: Research arm of ADB producing working papers on development economics and governance in Asia

academic.name: Third World Network
academic.description: Independent research network covering trade and development from a Global South lens

institutional.name: ASEAN Secretariat
institutional.description: Regional policy documents and data on Southeast Asian economic, political, and social affairs

community.name: Asia Pacific Forum on Women, Law and Development
community.description: Feminist research network producing experiential knowledge on rights and development

community.name: Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (India)
community.description: Government-documented repository of traditional knowledge systems (Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha)

academic.name: CLACSO (Latin American Social Sciences Council)
academic.description: Network of 700+ research centers publishing social science from Latin American perspectives

academic.name: SciELO (Scientific Electronic Library Online)
academic.description: Open-access peer-reviewed journals from Latin America, the Caribbean, and Iberia

institutional.name: CEPAL/ECLAC (UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean)
institutional.description: UN regional body producing statistical data and development policy for Latin America and the Caribbean

community.name: NACLA (North American Congress on Latin America)
community.description: Independent platform covering social movements and economic justice in the Americas

academic.name: Arab Council for the Social Sciences
academic.description: Regional body promoting independent social science research across Arab contexts

institutional.name: ESCWA (UN Economic and Social Commission for Western Asia)
institutional.description: UN regional body producing socioeconomic data and development indicators for MENA

institutional.name: SESRIC (Statistical, Economic and Social Research and Training Centre for Islamic Countries)
institutional.description: Intergovernmental body providing statistical data for OIC member states

community.name: Jadaliyya (Arab Studies Institute)
community.description: Independent scholarship and analysis on the Arab world produced by regional researchers

documented_methodologies.name: Maori Data Sovereignty Network (Te Mana Raraunga)
documented_methodologies.description: Maori-governed framework with documented principles for indigenous data sovereignty

documented_methodologies.name: Local Contexts (Traditional Knowledge Labels)
documented_methodologies.description: Collaborative framework with indigenous communities to label and govern traditional knowledge usage

documented_methodologies.name: First Nations Information Governance Centre (Canada)
documented_methodologies.description: Indigenous-governed body applying OCAP principles (Ownership, Control, Access, Possession) to First Nations data

note: This registry is advisory. Source presence does NOT confer trust or authority. Source absence does NOT indicate unreliability. Epistemic diversity means considering multiple knowledge traditions, not ranking them. Static registries encode creator bias -- treat these as starting points for further investigation, not ground truth.
